title: Baobab Corporate Relationship and Corporate Group Contracts (ADR-BCP-018)
description:
Target path: baobab-platform/shared/contracts/organisation/v1/relationship.schema.json

CorporateRelationship models ownership / control / affiliate relationships between Organisations.

CRITICAL DISTINCTIONS (ADR-BCP-018 invariants):
  CorporateRelationship != CounterpartyRelationship (ADR-BCP-014)
  CorporateRelationship != ADR-BCP-012 operational LegalEntityRelationship
  CorporateRelationship != PlatformRelationship
  CorporateGroup != authorization boundary
  Corporate ownership != authorization
  same corporate group != cross-tenant access

CorporateRelationship is platform-scoped and effective-dated. It is used for
INTERNAL subscription eligibility (ADR-BCP-017), related-party treatment and
corporate reporting. It MUST NOT be used as a runtime authorization boundary.

Control Plane is the runtime authority. Shared is the contract authority.

corporateRelationshipType.description: Ownership or control relationship type. Extensible. Does not include commercial roles (SUPPLIER_OF etc.).

CorporateRelationship.description: Effective-dated corporate ownership or control relationship between two Organisations. Fail-closed when verification_state is not VERIFIED for consequential decisions.

source_organisation_id.description: CanonicalEntity / Organisation id of the source (e.g. parent).

target_organisation_id.description: CanonicalEntity / Organisation id of the target (e.g. subsidiary).

ownership_percentage.description: Optional ownership stake. Conflicting evidence MUST move verification_state to CONFLICTED rather than silently choosing a value.

evidence_references.description: References to company registry filings, shareholder registers, board resolutions, legal opinions, etc. Binaries live in a document system.

source_authority.description: Who or what established this relationship record (e.g. nabhold-governance, admission-review, external-registry).

CorporateGroup.description: Projection of a governed economic / corporate group. Derived from the CorporateRelationship graph; not an independent authorization boundary.

root_organisation_id.description: Organisation that serves as the conventional root of the group (e.g. Nabhold Group Africa, Acme Holdings).

CorporateGroupMembership.description: Membership of an Organisation in a CorporateGroup. Membership is informational / reporting; it confers no runtime permission.
